goalsFilterAll.desc: Filter chip on the goals screen: show goals of every period or status

goalsFilterPeriod.desc: Screen reader label for the row of period filter chips on the goals screen

goalsFilterStatus.desc: Screen reader label for the status filter on the goals screen

goalsEmptyFiltered.desc: Shown when goals exist but none match the selected filters

goalsDueOn.desc: Goal deadline shown on a goal card, e.g. 'Due Nov 30, 2026'

goalsDeadline.desc: Field label in the goal editor

goalsNoDeadline.desc: Shown in the goal editor when no deadline is set

goalsSetDeadline.desc: Button in the goal editor to choose a deadline date

goalsRemoveDeadline.desc: Tooltip for clearing the deadline in the goal editor

goalsDescription.desc: Field label in the goal editor

goalsTitleLabel.desc: Field label for the goal title in the goal editor

goalsAmountWithUnit.desc: A number followed by the goal's unit, e.g. '12 pages'. Reorder if your language puts the unit first.

goalsCardSemantics.desc: Screen reader label for a goal card: title, progress such as '3 of 10', and status such as 'Active'

goalsReached.desc: Shown when progress in the current period meets the target

goalsLogged.desc: Snackbar after adding a goal progress entry

goalsEntryDeleted.desc: Snackbar after deleting a goal progress entry (with undo)

goalsDeleteEntry.desc: Tooltip for deleting one goal progress entry

goalsDeleted.desc: Snackbar after deleting a goal (with undo)

goalsMarkActive.desc: Menu action to make an achieved or paused goal active again

goalsNotFound.text: This goal is no longer available
goalsNotFound.desc: Shown when opening a goal that was deleted

goalsLinkTask.desc: Button to link an existing task to a goal

goalsNoLinkedTasks.desc: Empty state of the linked tasks section of a goal

goalsUnlinkTask.desc: Tooltip for removing the link between a task and a goal

goalsTaskOpen.desc: Screen reader state of a linked task that is not done

goalsTaskLinked.desc: Snackbar after linking a task to a goal

goalsTaskUnlinked.desc: Snackbar after unlinking a task from a goal (with undo)

goalsFromTasks.text: Includes {count, plural, =1{1 completed linked task} other{{count} completed linked tasks}} this period
goalsFromTasks.desc: Note under the goal progress ring explaining contributions from completed linked tasks

goalsHistoryAllTime.text: Entries from earlier periods are kept here but count only toward their own period.
goalsHistoryAllTime.desc: Explanation under the goal history header for non-long-term goals

goalsPercentOfTarget.desc: Under the progress ring, e.g. '40% of target'
